newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Floods kill 17 in south Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Floods kill 17 in south Philippines.

text.p: Seventeen people drowned when three rivers overflowed after more than a month of rains on Mindanao island in the southern Philippines, relief officials said on Thursday.
One person was missing in the floods which swept through 192 villages in four provinces and affected the homes of 125,000 people, the National Disaster Coordinating Council said in a report.
An earthquake measuring 7.0 on the Richter scale shook the area on Wednesday and started a fire in a hospital building in Cagayan de Oro city, but there were no casualties.
